electrical.avionics_note: FC, GPS, receiver at 5 V, assumed; catalogue lists no current draw

servo_supply.rule: torque and speed at 6.62 V: rested 7.36 V at 20% charge less 0.74 V sag at the pack's 58.5 A continuous rating; stall current at the full-charge 8.4 V

bec.note: built into the flap ESC; its mass is in the BOM with the ESC

assumptions: Section polar e387-film: cd factor 1.2 for film over ribs: an assumption with no published source
Motor rotor inertia estimated from mass and diameter; not published.
Battery internal resistance estimated from claimed C rate; not published.
Servo current is the SPEC M8 estimate: stall current x (torque / stall torque), idle if published.
Tail polar is an assumed thin plate.
Gear trains mix steel pinions or gears with acetal mates of the same module; each gear is held to its own published rating.

Twist servo at the elbow drives the hand wing through a mtube-tigertitanium-ti3al2.5v-6.35x5.54 torque tube; M7 checks its torsion against the published minimum yield through von Mises (tau = sigma_y / sqrt 3).
Twist horn linkage ratio is geometry: the servo's published torque and speed are scaled by it; linkage backlash and compliance not modelled.

Servos run straight off the 2S pack (HV servos; no regulator): torque and speed from the published rows at 6.62 V, stall current at the full-charge 8.4 V (above the top published row it is scaled by the voltage ratio).
Crank speed governor: a drive-firmware function (ESC or flight controller with the crank encoder); the catalogue ESC publishes no governor mode.
Drive-side current clamp at 34 A in the governor (duty <= (E + I R)/V from commutation speed and input voltage): a firmware function the catalogue ESC does not publish.
One crank pin drives both couplers; the left wing flies its own mirrored linkage (left-right stroke difference in design.packing).

Rigid elbow: the outer spar is bonded into the inner one (spigot); the arm wing's own share of the twist (twist weights 0-0.3 inboard of the elbow) has no mechanism in the BOM and is a kinematic assumption.
Derived parts: stroke-servo pushrods and yoke, pitot-static probe (bases in the structure list); pitot pressure lines counted in the 15% margin with the wiring.
Bearings placed by the drive (drive.bearings); their load ratings are not checked (shoulder pivots react the coupler force).

Stroke envelope measured by flight test in calm air at a fraction of the gear, spar, coupler and servo ratings (control.envelopeAllowance: a rough-air allowance, a design choice); M7 judges full ratings on the flown loads.

packing.checker: sims/avis-shared/model.js prepare/layoutParts/fitReport (film workstream), used as is

control.dtRule: round 4: the step at which M4 peaks converge (half step changes them < 10%), not the 60-steps-per-cycle rule

envelopeAllowance.note: fraction of each rating the calm-air envelope may use, leaving the rest for rough-air load increments; M7 judges the full rating against the loads of the flights themselves

selection.basis: explicit round-4 parameters (ROUND4, ROUND4_OPT in the script and --set/--opt) on the round-3 Larus v9; screen not rerun

performance.method: src/physics/scenarios.js runClimb: closed loop with the flight controller, its stroke envelope and current limit; climb from 15 s to 45 s of steady climb, no wind, battery full; best over commanded climb rates 0.5-3 m/s
performance.for_environment: the corridor can be re-solved to this climb with a margin: a gradient at speed V is climb / V
